aaa_enabled.summary: Configure Identity Provider (SAML/SSO) in the ZIA Admin Portal.
aaa_enabled.notes: Go to ZIA Admin Portal > Administration > Identity Provider (IdP) to configure SAML SSO.

secure_vty_transport.summary: ZIA portal strictly enforces secure HTTPS administration connections.
secure_vty_transport.notes: HTTP and legacy cleartext console connections are not supported in ZIA.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Configure session timeout in Advanced Settings.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: Go to ZIA Admin Portal > Administration > Advanced Settings > Session Timeout to configure administrative timeouts.

enable_secret_encrypted.notes: Local user databases in ZIA automatically hash password credentials.

no_default_snmp_community.notes: Zscaler cloud endpoints do not expose traditional SNMP agent access.

http_server_disabled.notes: HTTP administrative connections are not supported by ZIA Admin Portal.

ssh_version_2.notes: SSH management access is not supported on ZIA cloud consoles.

logging_enabled.summary: Configure Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS) log forwarding.
logging_enabled.notes: Go to ZIA Admin Portal > Administration > Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS) to define NSS feeds for log forwarding.

management_acl.summary: Configure source IP restrictions for administrators.
management_acl.notes: Go to ZIA Admin Portal > Administration > Administrator Management > Edit Administrator to configure Allowed Source IP ranges.

login_banner.notes: Go to ZIA Admin Portal > Administration > SAML Authentication to set SAML warning screens.

password_min_length.notes: Go to ZIA Admin Portal > Administration > Administrator Management > Password Policy.

ntp_configured.summary: Time synchronization is managed automatically by Zscaler Cloud.
ntp_configured.notes: Zscaler cloud nodes synchronize time automatically with internal NTP servers.

no_write_snmp_community.notes: Legacy SNMP read-write is not applicable to ZIA cloud instances.
